newsitem.title: ITALY: Belgian friar, two teachers kidnapped in Zaire.
newsitem.headline: Belgian friar, two teachers kidnapped in Zaire.

text.p: A Franciscan friar and two Roman Catholic teachers were kidnapped in Zaire on Monday, the friar's order said on Saturday.
Friar Raoul Buisseret, 52, a Belgian, and the two teachers were abducted by "irregular soldiers" while travelling in eastern Zaire, the Frati Minori said in a statement.

Members gathering for a general assembly in Assisi, the home town of Saint Francis, heard the head of the order in Zaire, Stanislas Lukumwena, appeal for a message from Pope John Paul to Zaire's warring factions asking for the release of the priest and teachers.
